subject: Payment & AP eligibility check — SentryVR procurement next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Cole <emma.cole@sentryvr.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Payment & AP eligibility check — SentryVR procurement next steps

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can lock the procurement path: 

Recap (what we heard)
- SentryVR is planning a 3-month pilot of Redwood Hosted API for inference (initial forecast ~$7k).
- Procurement/finance generally prefers POs for recurring SaaS spend, but pilots sometimes go on virtual card depending on spend bucket.
- Vendor onboarding requires W9, insurance cert, and vendor profile in your supplier portal.

Questions / asks from our side
1) AP threshold: can you confirm SentryVR's PO vs card threshold? On the call you mentioned $5k+ requires PO — please confirm.
2) Timeline: When would procurement be able to issue a PO if we move forward (e.g., 2 weeks, 4 weeks)?
3) Marketplace: Are you open to procuring through AWS Marketplace (hosted billing) vs direct PO? Using Marketplace can speed onboarding for Hosted API but doesn't cover Dedicated/Private.
4) Procurement contact: please share the vendor onboarding contact (name + email) and any registration link.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (checklist we use), SentryVR-SOW-draft-v1.pdf (initial SOW placeholder).

Next steps we propose
- If PO: provide vendor registration link and target PO date; we'll return a signed SOW + Redwood vendor form.
- If card for pilot: we can accept virtual card for pilot budgets under the threshold — will need billing contact.

I'll follow up with Rishi (cc'd) for formal payment terms and vendor form. Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Cole <emma.cole@sentryvr.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, SentryVR Procurement <procurement@sentryvr.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment & AP eligibility check — SentryVR procurement next steps

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Confirmed: Our AP policy requires a PO for SaaS vendor spend above $5,000/month or $15,000 annualized (exceptions made case-by-case). Pilots under $5k can sometimes be handled with a virtual card (depends on vendor risk & contract).
- Timeline: Typical PO issuance is 2–3 weeks once vendor registration is complete.
- Marketplace: We prefer Marketplace for third-party SaaS if it’s available — it helps our central procurement team because billing goes through our Marketplace contract. However, Marketplace billing is limited to hosted/managed offerings; if you offer Dedicated or Private installations billed via contract, that would still require a PO.

I'll pull in our supplier onboarding team. They need a completed vendor form, W9, and proof of insurance. I'll attach our PO template and vendor intake doc in a follow-up.

Can Rishi confirm Redwood's support for PO + Net30 terms and whether you have a vendor portal link?

Best,
Emma Cole
Head of Finance Operations | SentryVR
emma.cole@sentryvr.com

> On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 2:03 PM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the call earlier today...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Cole <emma.cole@sentryvr.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment & AP eligibility check — SentryVR procurement next steps

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the detail. Quick answers from Redwood: 
- PO + Net30: Yes, Redwood accepts POs with Net30 payment terms for enterprise customers (we route to finance and account ops for onboarding once PO is received).
- Vendor requirements: We can complete your vendor intake; attached is a PDF form (Redwood-vendor-form.pdf) and we'll return a signed SOW. We also provide W9 and current COI on request.
- Marketplace: We support AWS Marketplace billing for Redwood Hosted API subscriptions (that path will be billed through AWS Marketplace and follows AWS invoicing). Marketplace does not support Dedicated or Private deployments — those require a direct PO/contract.
- Virtual card: For pilots under your $5k threshold we can accept virtual card payments; helpful for faster start, but onboarding steps (vendor profile) are still recommended for long-term procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Emma/procurement: share the supplier registration link & preferred PO template (or grant us access to your portal).
2) Redwood: we'll upload the vendor form + W9 and provide a signed SOW (please confirm any SOW redline owners/contact).
3) If Marketplace is preferred for the pilot: confirm the product listing name and we can provide the Marketplace offer id.

I'll loop Legal if there are contract redlines. Happy to jump on a 20-min call with procurement to walk through the vendor portal.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference
